lines.text: Measure would amend the East Palo Alto Municipal Code to establish term limits for
Currently, the Municipal Code does not limit how long an individual may serve on the
City Council. This measure would limit individuals to a maximum of three (3) consecutive four-
year terms, or a total of twelve (12) years. A partial term of more than two (2) years would count
The limitation would apply only to terms that begin after the ordinance takes effect,
which under Elections Code Section 9217, would be in December 2026. Any terms served by an
individual on the City Council before that date would not count towards the term limit.
This measure was placed on the ballot by the City Council of the City of East Palo Alto.
It requires a majority vote to pass.
Voting "Yes" means adopting these term limits for City Councilmembers.
Voting "No" means City Councilmembers would not be subject to term limits.
